As a Logistics Employee, you will work within a logistics team in Eindhoven and be responsible for processing incoming and outgoing goods. You maintain an overview, work accurately, and help ensure a smooth logistics process together with your colleagues.

Your tasks include:

- Working in a 2-shift schedule from 06:00 – 15:00 and 15:00 – 00:00
- Scanning, sorting, and labeling goods
- Collecting and preparing orders for shipment
- Loading and unloading trucks using an EPT or forklift
- Moving goods within the warehouse and production environment
- Processing logistics data in the warehouse management system
- Checking goods for quantities and quality

You will receive a shift allowance for working in shifts according to the applicable employment conditions.

- Good command of the English language
- Physically fit and comfortable with physical work
- Available to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Willing to occasionally work on Saturday mornings
- Accurate working attitude and able to work independently and in a team

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience with an EPT or forklift
- A valid forklift or EPT certificate, or willingness to obtain one through WerkTalent
- Living in the Eindhoven region or willing to travel

- Serve as a trusted advisor to both Area Sales Managers and clients, spotting business opportunities and driving sales growth.

- Customer-focused, proactive, and an excellent communicator.

- Energetic, self-starting, enterprising, and positive in approach.

As a logistics employee, you play an important role in the warehouse and distribution process. You make sure goods are handled safely, correctly and on time.

Your tasks are:

- Loading and unloading trucks.
- Packing, sorting and labelling products.
- Preparing orders and processing returns.
- Checking the quality and quantity of goods.
- Registering your work in the system.
- Solving small deviations and keeping the warehouse tidy.
- Moving goods with an EPT and sometimes with a forklift.

You work from Monday to Friday in 2 shifts. One week you work from 06:00 to 15:00. The other week you work from 15:00 to 00:00.

- You speak and understand English.
- You have experience in logistics.
- You enjoy working in a logistics environment.
- You are willing to work in 2 shifts.
- You have an EPT or forklift certificate, or you are willing to obtain one.
- You live in or near Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel or Valkenswaard.

Do you get energized by supporting a complex manufacturing process and driving structural improvements through data? In this role you will directly support the Production Engineering teams of a high-tech manufacturing organisation. By navigating a large-scale data migration and building advanced visualisation tools, you make sure the engineering organisation has the exact insights needed to optimise quality, cycle time and efficiency on the shopfloor. Organisatie 
You will join a multidisciplinary engineering department with English as the working language. Day to day you support Production Engineers, collaborating with data engineers, first line support and factory stakeholders to align cross-functional data streams. Functie 
The Factory Engineering department sets the pace for industrialisation and continuous improvement. The production engineering teams are currently operating in an environment undergoing a full-scale ERP migration to SAP, which introduces complex challenges around data mapping, data quality and legacy system integration. 
The goal of the team is to enable engineering and factory strategies by transforming raw transactional data into clean, actionable business intelligence, and to deliver high-end dashboarding and reporting solutions that support Production Engineers in improving cycle time, quality and cost.

As a Cleanroom Operator, you play an important role in maintaining the quality of high-tech products used in industries such as semiconductors and electronics. You will work in a controlled cleanroom environment where accuracy, safety, and quality are essential.

Your daily tasks include:

- Cleaning high-tech components according to cleanroom procedures and work instructions.
- Performing assembly work using hand tools and technical drawings.
- Inspecting products and carrying out quality measurements.
- Preparing and cleaning metal frames and packaging materials according to protocol.
- Reporting deviations and registering quality findings in the production system.
- Reading and following technical drawings and work instructions accurately.
- Keeping your workplace clean, safe, and organized according to cleanroom standards.

Working hours

You will work from Monday to Friday in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 – 15:00
- Evening shift: 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts. Overtime on Saturdays or Sundays is paid at 150% when applicable.

Required

- Good command of the English language.
- Ability to read technical drawings and work instructions.
- Technical insight or experience within a production environment.
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule.
- Living in or within travelling distance of Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, or Valkenswaard.

Preferred

- Experience working in a cleanroom environment.
- Experience with assembly work or high-tech production.

Are you looking for a logistics job with the chance of a permanent contract? Do you want to receive your salary every week? Are you physically strong and enjoy active work? If so, keep reading – this could be the right job for you!

What are you going to do?
As a warehouse employee in the Shipping team you are responsible for order picking, packing and picking of products, maintaining the warehouse and keeping track of inventory. The work instructions are in English, you follow them as correctly as possible. In addition, you are a team player and willing to support other teams when necessary. Together with your team you ensure that you meet the daily demand and quality. This is a full-time job, you will work from Monday to Friday starting at 09.00 AM until 17.30 PM. 

What do we offer?
In addition to an attractive salary starting at €2,650 gross per month, we offer:

- Weekly salary payments.
- 8% vacation allowance and 25 vacation days (full-time).
- Travel allowance.
- Participation in the pension fund from day one.
- Personal development opportunities via access to the Adecco Academy, an online platform with various training and courses.

Where will you work?
Super Micro is a world leader in IT products. The servers are built in Den Bosch, where they have their own production department. After the production of the servers, they need to be shipped on time. ? Besides a nice salary, you will be compensated for your travel expenses. When the client is satisfied with you, and you with them, it is possible to get a permanent contract. Besides that you have a lot of (international) colleagues to work with.

What do we ask?
- You switch quickly between different work activities;
- You work well under pressure and with deadlines;
- You speak and write excellent English;
- In addition, you are resourceful, driven, accurate and a real team player. 

Are you interested?
Apply quickly via the application button!

Want more information? Contact Layla Venn at 06 43446012

Are you looking to start your career as a full-time Office Administrator in Den Bosch?

Are you highly organised , proactive and confident with computer and people skills?

Do you have excellent written and spoken English & Dutch?

Then this could be your next exciting career move!

What are you going to do?
Join Supermicro as an Office Administrator to support daily operational and administrative activities within the facilities team. We are looking for someone proactive, organised, and comfortable working in a fast‑paced environment, with strong administrative skills.What do we offer?
- Excellent command of Dutch and English.
- At least 2 years experience working in an administrative role with strong attention to detail.

Supermicro are a global leader in IT, you can kickstart your career and help maintain the smooth running of the facilities office! We're looking for enthusiastic people like you to join the Facilities team in Den Bosch.

- Process invoices and maintain accurate administrative records.

As a Maintenance Employee, you will work on maintaining and repairing packaging for fragile high-tech components. You will follow clear instructions and work together with colleagues to ensure a safe and efficient production process.

Your tasks include:

- Repairing and inspecting packaging according to checklists and work instructions
- Performing preventive maintenance on packaging materials
- Working with hand tools and technical equipment
- Identifying and reporting deviations during the production process
- Registering repairs and inspections in the system
- Loading, unloading, and transporting materials with an EPT or forklift
- Collaborating with colleagues to maintain quality and safety standards

You will work in a 2-shift schedule:

- Week 1: 06:00 – 15:00
- Week 2: 15:00 – 00:00

The shifts alternate weekly.

During your onboarding period, you will receive extensive training and guidance to become familiar with the tasks and tools required for the role.

- Technical insight and a practical working attitude
- Experience with maintenance work and reading technical drawings
- Experience using hand tools and operating an EPT or forklift
- Forklift certificate is preferred or can be obtained through WerkTalent
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Good command of the English language (minimum B1 level)
- Accurate and independent working attitude

Are you looking for an fun, challenging full-time job? Are you a go-getter and do you speak English? Do you like working with your hands and in a small warehouse? Look no further! This is job as warehouse employee is for you! You'll earn around € 15,00 to € 16,- per hour 💸, have 25 vacation days 🏖️ and start building up pension from day 1! Read on and apply direct! #MKB

What we offer
- Earn € 15,- to € 16,- per hour!
- Fulltime job!
- Nice small team!
- From 09:00 - 17:00 from Monday - Friday!
- 25 vacation days!
- Helmond!

Who you are
You want to work as a warehouse employee and enjoy getting things done. Heavier products, up to a maximum of 20 kilos, are no problem for you. You speak the English language fluently. Also, you are full-time available and in possession of a forklift certificate. Or willing to get one!

What will you do
As a warehouse employee, you will work full-time day shifts from 09:00 - 17:00. Your day starts with placing products in boxes or arranging them on pallets. You'll pick orders with precision, package products securely, and unload containers filled with goods. Operating a forklift might be part of your tasks, loading pallets into trucks efficiently. It’s a dynamic and hands-on role that keeps you moving throughout the day!

Where will you work
As a warehouse employee, you will be employed at a wholesale company with an international focus. The location where you will be working is in Helmond. It's a international, small and friendly team. There is a great and enjoyable work atmosphere! Part-time work is not possible and you will receive no travel allowance.

As a Cleanroom Operator, you are responsible for cleaning, inspecting, and preparing technical components used in industries such as semiconductors, aerospace, and medical technology. You will work according to strict cleanroom procedures and ensure every product meets the required quality standards.

Your responsibilities include:

- Cleaning technical components and packaging materials according to cleanroom protocols.
- Performing visual inspections and quality checks on finished products.
- Assembling and packaging products according to work instructions.
- Reading and following technical drawings and production instructions.
- Registering and reporting deviations during the production process.
- Refilling cleaning materials and maintaining the required stock levels.
- Keeping the cleanroom and your workstation clean, safe, and organized.

You will work in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 – 15:00
- Afternoon shift: 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

- Experience in a production or cleanroom environment
- Technical insight and the ability to read technical drawings and work instructions.
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule.
- Good command of the English language.
- Structured, accurate, and independent working attitude.
- Living in the Eindhoven region or willing to travel

In your own delivery van, you will drive independently through the region to deliver orders neatly to consumers and businesses. Your favorite music playing in the cabin, out on the open road, and staying physically active—it's the ideal combination! 🎶📦

What we offer
- A salary up to € 18,83 per hour !
- Opportunity for a permanent contract 🎉

- You receive a travel allowance and a pension plan

You are an enthusiastic and social driver who prioritizes safety and customer friendliness. At the front door, you serve as a professional ambassador, and you have no problem staying physically active, such as walking up stairs with deliveries. Physical work is easy for you! You can effortlessly lift crates weighing up to 22 kg. 💪 Furthermore, you recognize yourself in the following points:

- You have a car available and have held your driver's license for at least 6 months. 🚗
- You are available at least 2 days a week (including at least one weekend day or evening shift). 🗓️

What will you do
As a delivery driver, your shift starts at the hub or depot. After a cup of coffee and a brief catch-up with your colleagues, you inspect your vehicle and the loaded orders. Then you hop in and hit the road!

Using a handy navigation system, you drive safely from address to address. Once you arrive at the customer's location, you carry the crates or boxes neatly up to the front door. You engage in a brief chat, collect any return items, and handle the delivery efficiently. After completing your route, you drive back to the depot, park the van neatly, and wrap up a satisfying workday together with your colleagues! ✅

Day shift: 1:00 PM – 9:30 PM

- Carefully load, unload, and arrange parcels according to schedule
